Considering the traffic demands from tram and general vehicles, it can reduce the traffic delay of general vehicles while minimizing the need for trams to stop at the intersection. Real-time traffic information is used to dynamically adjust the sequence of traffic signals throughout the whole passing process of the tram, without relying on the complex traffic modeling. We use deep Q-network algorithm for problem-solving, and adopt dueling network, double Q network, and prioritized experience replay to improve the learning performance. Experiments based on SUMO have demonstrated that the proposed model can excellently improve the efficiency of trams and general vehicles simultaneously.
